Prep time: 15 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 15 minutes Number of Servings: 7 Ingredients 16 ounces silken tofu* 3 ripe bananas (mash 2, slice 1) 2 Tablespoons sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla Directions Wash hands with soap and water. Combine tofu, 2 mashed bananas, sugar and vanilla. Blend until smooth. Pour into a serving bowl or dishes. Cover and refrigerate until chilled. Top with sliced banana just before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: *Soft or silken tofu has a creamy texture that blends easily.
